quote: Following common practice, we used MAP@5, NDCG@5, Precision@5 (P@5), MAP@10, NDCG@10, and Precision@10 to evaluate the ranking scores of candidate datasets computed by each method, averaged over all test queries.

We followed  to randomly divide 20 candidate datasets into 5 groups and prompted GLM to rerank each group. We repeated this process 10 times. The ranking score of a candidate dataset was given by its frequency of appearing in the top half of a reranked group.
methods: reranking candidate datasets based on query and target datasets
